_comment: PROTOTYPE MOCK SOP GUIDANCE — not official government SOPs.

sops.title: Road Damage Complaint Handling (Mock)
steps: Verify complaint location using submitted address or coordinates.
Assign field inspector — target within 48 hours of receipt.
Inspector documents damage with photos and condition report.
Engineer classifies severity (minor / moderate / severe / critical).
Work order raised in maintenance system.
Citizen notified of scheduled repair date.
Post-repair verification by inspector.
Complaint closed with photo evidence.
sops.escalation_trigger: No field inspection within 72 hours — escalate to department head.

sops.title: Waste Collection Complaint Handling (Mock)
steps: Confirm complaint address is in service zone.
Check scheduled collection calendar for the address.
If missed collection: dispatch supplementary truck within 24 hours.
If illegal dumping: coordinate with enforcement unit.
Citizen notified of resolution timeline.
Complaint closed after confirmation of collection.
sops.escalation_trigger: Health hazard confirmed — escalate immediately to DLH emergency team.

sops.title: Traffic Management Complaint Handling (Mock)
steps: Identify complaint type: signal failure / congestion / illegal parking / signage.
For signal failure: dispatch technician within 2 hours.
For congestion: review CCTV and coordinate with field officers.
For illegal parking: coordinate with Satpol PP if needed.
Document action taken.
Citizen notified of outcome.
sops.escalation_trigger: Signal failure at major intersection — treat as critical.
